Instructions.Text: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook pasta until al dente.
Season chicken breasts with salt and pepper, then pan-sear in olive oil over medium-high heat until golden and cooked through.
Remove chicken from the pan and set aside to rest.
In the same pan, add minced garlic and cook for 30–60 seconds until fragrant.
Pour in heavy cream and simmer gently, stirring to combine.
Stir in grated parmesan cheese until the sauce is smooth and creamy.
Slice the chicken and return it to the sauce.
Add drained pasta and toss until fully coated in the sauce.
Serve immediately with extra parmesan and freshly cracked black pepper.
